texts.label: 01  WHEN TO GO
texts.head: Be there at 8:45
texts.body: Quietest right at opening. Last entry is 4 p.m.

texts.label: 02  WHAT TO SEE
texts.head: Palace first, gardens later
texts.body: It is a one-way walk in socks. Tour groups slow it down.

texts.label: 03  LISTEN
texts.head: The floors chirp
texts.body: Old boards and nails, probably not an alarm.

texts.label: 04  GOOD TO KNOW
texts.head: No photos inside
texts.body: The palace is closed on Tuesdays in Jan, Jul, Aug and Dec.

texts.label: SAVE THIS
texts.head: Send it to your travel buddy.
